project.title: The Company That Sells You Nothing

editorialThesis: Every visual advances understanding, evidence, emotion, or curiosity. Long holds require staged discovery or a deliberate payoff.

selected.claim: 20.8 MILLION MEMBERS. But the room is still mostly empty.
selected.question: Why does this business model work?

candidates.claim: 20.8 MILLION MEMBERS. But the room is still mostly empty.
candidates.question: Why does this business model work?

candidates.claim: The strange part isn't how many people pay. It's how few can show up.
candidates.question: Why would underuse be valuable?

candidates.claim: A tiny fraction of customers showing up at once would hit the physical limit.
candidates.question: Why is non-use economically useful?

candidates.claim: The customer who keeps paying can be more valuable than the customer who keeps using.
candidates.question: What happens when inertia becomes part of the economics?

candidates.claim: 20.8 MILLION MEMBERS members. ~7,200 MEMBERS / CLUB. Those two numbers should not fit together.
candidates.question: What is the missing piece?

candidates.claim: This empty room is not a failure. It is evidence.
candidates.question: Evidence of what?

candidates.claim: The business can become more profitable when customers use less of what they bought.
candidates.question: How can that be rational and repeatable?

candidates.claim: You do not have to stop loving the product for the company to profit from you barely using it.
candidates.question: Why would a customer relationship reward inertia?
